blocks.text: gtkmm provides four basic types of buttons:
blocks.zh: gtkmm 提供以下四种基本按钮控件：

blocks.text:
[`Gtk::Button`](&url_refdocs_base_gtk_html;classGtk_1_1Button.html). Standard buttons, usually
marked with a label or picture. Pushing one triggers an action. See the [Button](#sec-pushbuttons) section.
blocks.zh: Gtk::Button。这是标准按钮，通常标有文字标签或者图片。按一下就会触发一个动作。参看 Button 小节。

blocks.text:
[`Gtk::ToggleButton`](&url_refdocs_base_gtk_html;classGtk_1_1ToggleButton.html).
Unlike a normal Button, which springs back up, a ToggleButton stays down until you
press it again. It might be useful as an on/off switch. See the [ToggleButton](#sec-toggle-buttons) section.
blocks.zh: Gtk::ToggleButton。和一般按下后会自动弹起的按钮不一样，ToggleButton 需要你再按一次才会弹起。它作为一个开关可能比较有用。参看 ToggleButton 小节。

blocks.text:
[`Gtk::CheckButton`](&url_refdocs_base_gtk_html;classGtk_1_1CheckButton.html).
These act like ToggleButtons, but show their state in small squares,
with their label at the side. They should be used in most situations
which require an on/off setting.
See the [CheckButton](#sec-checkbuttons) section.
blocks.zh: Gtk::CheckButton。它们用起来和 ToggleButtons 很像，只不过它们用一个小方块来显示自己的状态，而且旁边还有一个文字标签。在大多数需要布尔值设置的情况都可以使用它。参看 CheckButton 小节。

blocks.text:
Named after the station selectors on old car
radios, these buttons are used in groups for options which are
mutually exclusive. Pressing one causes all the
others in its group to turn off. They are similar to ToggleButtons or
CheckButtons (a small widget with a label at the side), but usually
look different. There is no separate radio button class. Check buttons
and toggle buttons can act as radio buttons.
See the [Radio Button](#sec-radio-buttons) section.
blocks.zh: 它是根据老式汽车内的收音机的选台器来命名的，选台器是一组选择按钮并且它们是互斥的。按下其中任何一个都会使这一组中的其它按钮都弹起。它们的布局和 CheckButton (一个旁边有标签的小部件)很相似，但是通常看起来不太一样。没有单独的单选按钮类。复选按钮和开关按钮可以充当单选按钮。参见RadioButton 小节。

blocks.text:
Note that, due to GTK's theming system, the appearance of these
widgets will vary. In the case of check buttons and radio buttons, they
may vary considerably.
blocks.zh: 请注意，由于GTK的主题不同，这些控件外观可能会不同。特别是复选按钮和单选按钮可能会很不一样。

blocks.text:
There are two ways to create a Button. You can specify a label
string in the `Gtk::Button` constructor,
or set it later with set_label().
blocks.zh: 可以通过两种方式来创建按钮，你可以在 Gtk::Button 构造函数中指定标签字符串，或者以后调用 set_label() 来指定标签。

blocks.text:
`Gtk::Button` is also
a container so you could put any other widget, such as a
`Gtk::Image` into it.
blocks.zh: Gtk::Button 同时也是一个容器，因此你可以在其中放任何其它的部件，比如放一个 Gtk::Image 在里面。

blocks.text:
The `Gtk::Button` widget has the `clicked` signal
which is emitted when the button is pressed and released.
blocks.zh: Gtk::Button部件具有clicked信号，当按下或释放按钮时将会发出该信号。
